about_the_game:
Wanna "Arthur's Quest: Between the Big Sword and the Bara Spirits" H-scenes in your pocket and check the game's backstage?

This DLC contains a PDF with all H-scenes presented in the game and backstage (in terms of art). You'll be able to check how we created the characters, their sketches, and much more. In other words, you'll get:

  • A PDF with all H-scenes presented in the game and backstage, including sketches from the scenes and characters' art process!

↳ To access it, you need to go to the location:

📁 C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Arthur's Quest\Arthur's Quest - Adult Art Pack.pdf

content_descriptors.notes: Arthur's Quest - Adult Art Pack contains images with explicit sexual relationships between men, like blowjobs and anal sex.
